name: Rue des Gestes — étape 2 · tirer, se lever, accrocher
note: Tiered verb place; all six verbs are -er, so they all live on the LEFT cottages (the right side is a low stone wall with hedges, no verbs). Tiers: street (man pulling the pulley rope that lifts a tea tray, old man springing up from his lever armchair beside a tall mirror, man loading sacks onto a horse), balcony (boy dragging a toy train), upper (woman leaning on the sill by her puppy and little mirror), roof (granny hanging her crochet blanket on a hook). Forward = far lane; back = near cobbles.
